verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform or API, so a sandbox test environment separate from production data is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API or developer surface that would make the axis apply: the OpenAPI probes all return 404, and the only online tool is an investor-readiness checker.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
